d: Android to PS Vita port of Gameloft's Dungeon Hunter 3
ld: A native port of Gameloft's **Dungeon Hunter 3** (Android, v1.5.2c) to the PlayStation Vita, built on the so-loader technique: the original Android `libDH3.so` is relocated and run directly on the Vita, with a FalsoJNI-based bridge standing in for the parts of the Android runtime the game calls into (Java callbacks, file system, OBB, input, audio, video, IME), rendering through a patched vitaGL built from source.
req:
- Install kubridge.skprx and ur0:data/libshacccg.suprx if you don't have them already.
- Copy your own game data to ux0:data/dungeonhunter3/ (layout in the README).
- [Getting the game data](#-installation) for what you need to supply yourself.
- Copy the files above to ux0:data/dungeonhunter3/.
- On the Vita: kubridge (https://github.com/bythos14/kubridge) and libshacccg.suprx (see [Prerequisites](#-prerequisites)).
- > Game files are never distributed. You always need your own legally obtained copy of the game.
